biology: It lives in the soil and is very rare.
soldier: The head is reddish yellow, slightly darker anteriorly; mandibles brownish black, antennae yellow, abdomen white; the whole body densely covered with short hairs. The head is tubular and rectangular in dorsal view, the sides parallel, the posterior margin slightly arcuate. At one-fifth of the anterior end of the head the middle rises into a pointed ridge, behind which the dorsum of the head forms an indistinct slope and gradually descends; in front of the ridge a slope of 45 degrees descends to the anterior end of the head, with a longitudinal groove in the middle of the slope. The fontanelle lies on the anterior slope near the apex of the ridge. The labrum is about as long as wide, the left anterolateral corner projecting as a needle, the right anterolateral corner sharp but not needle-like; the anterior margin oblique. The mandibles are slightly shorter than the head; the right mandible is shorter and straighter than the left, its anterior end sharp; the torsion of the left mandible is gentler, its apex directed to the right, and there is another tooth-like process at the base of the mandible pointing down and to the right. The postmentum bulges distinctly towards the ventral surface, narrow posteriorly and gradually widening in front of the midpoint, widest at the anterior end. Antennae with 14 segments, segments 3 and 4 equal and shorter than segment 2. The raised part of the pronotum is about the same size as the posterior part, the middle of the anterior margin slightly depressed.
